findings.desc: CHK-001:happy:0, CHK-001:edge:0, and CHK-001:adversarial:0 all have stale verificationEvidence at current HEAD. Evidence was recorded at commits 9fa9d239d/056d3e7f8/12e7c113d before CHK-002 hardening commit 172b55142 modified the rev 3 doc (533 insertions, 181 deletions). The validate CLI reports these 3 must-intents as stale-not-valid (3/6 covered). Substantively, my independent checks confirm all three intents are actually satisfied at current HEAD (section headings verified, shasum 2ef4122e... reproduced, CJK=0 confirmed, supersession clause present at line 8), but the evidence headHashes must be refreshed to remove the gate block. Resolution: re-run verification_evidence_add for each of the three CHK-001 intents against the current HEAD so validate reports 6/6 covered.
